criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 3 is the deck's best image and passes the showstopper test at 432 px; 8 has a real pool on the lectern; 5 is the strongest land frame though its horizon is ruled and the seam lights are missing. 6 pale flat-lit boxes on a ruled horizon against black, its line entering lower right against 5's camera; 2 a flat diagram with a black channel band; 4 a primitive slab on tiled crust; 7 a band of dead wall and box chairs; 1 and 9 sign faces flat-lit with no town name.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One accent meaning, the sign bookend as spine, the value cut at 7 lands. The 5 to 6 camera move fails, 2 sits outside the deck, 4's mid-brown ground is one value bump.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the core rests on the primary notice. Slide 3 states the $220 million without Tribune attribution, the vote rests on journalism, and 'doesn't reach it' steps past 'circumventing'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, who decides, where, and when and how to act are all delivered; the abatement's worth is absent because the notice doesn't say it.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 3 to 6 build, 7 turns. 8 steps back out of the forward motion and would sit better before 7.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Specific and on register with regional nouns. Slide 3's last sentence is clunky.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Subject, palette and accent diverge from nos. 71 to 73; the house chassis is the familiar move.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 6 as the payoff, from frame 5's side of the line at about fov 12, with the unit filling a third of the frame in its own pool against a graded dusk sky and with surface detail.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: small pale flat-lit unit on a ruled horizon against black, the line entering lower right
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: mirror the camera so the line enters lower left, fov about 12, a key pool on its left flank, sky haze falling to dark

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: a 2D diagram at feed size with a black channel band and a dashed road
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: eye about 250 m at a lower oblique, the near corner in a lit pool with grass and a modelled shoulder, riprap with a specular water edge

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: untextured slab, low-poly clods, tiled crust, mid-tone ground
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: chamfered grained lath with limp flagging at its head, camera about 0.4 m, pool tight on the foot

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: dead wall between dek and dais, box chairs, no window
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: raise and tilt down so rows and dais fill from y 900, a left-wall window as a cool rim

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: sticker-flat face with no town name, reflectors in a lane
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: STARBASE above CITY LIMIT, retroreflective falloff, reflectors on the centre line
